subject.title: fix(sessions): reject altered visible message cursors

question: Should visible-message cursor aliases that decode to the same position remain tolerated, or should the SDK enforce the proposed opaque canonical-token boundary?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and proven, but it deliberately changes the continuation behavior of previously accepted altered inputs, so maintainers must own that compatibility contract.

options.title: Enforce canonical opaque cursors
options.body: Merge the patch so only cursors emitted unchanged by OpenClaw continue, and altered representations take the established reset path.

options.title: Preserve alias tolerance
options.body: Keep accepting semantically equivalent rewritten cursor encodings and do not merge this strict validation boundary.

recommendation.title: Enforce canonical opaque cursors
recommendation.body: Merge the patch so only cursors emitted unchanged by OpenClaw continue, and altered representations take the established reset path.
